title: What if the Moon vanished tonight? 🌑
subject: moon
description:
What would you miss first? 👇

What would happen to Earth if the Moon disappeared? Darker nights and weaker tides come first, but the biggest change is the slowest one: Earth's tilt.

Sources: Ocean Motion / NASA ("Tide-Generating Forces"), Australian Institute of Marine Science via The Conversation ("Mass coral spawning"), Laskar, Joutel & Robutel, Nature (1993), Li & Batygin, ApJ (2014) "On the Spin-axis Dynamics of a Moonless Earth", Live Science ("What would happen if the moon disappeared?")
tags: what would happen without the moon

scenes.text: If the Moon vanished tonight, nights would turn truly dark.
Animals that hunt by moonlight would lose their clock.
Within hours, tides would shrink. The Sun's pull on the ocean is only 46% of the Moon's.
Corals that spawn by the Moon's phases would lose their calendar.
But here's the strange part. The biggest change is the slowest.
The Moon steadies Earth's tilt. Without it, scientists think the tilt could slowly drift over millions of years. And it would all begin quietly.
